claims.statement: On September 17, 2026, Si-Ware announced the opening of its Austin office as its new US headquarters and Physical AI innovation center.
claims.text: On September 17, 2026, Si-Ware announced the opening of its Austin office as its new US headquarters and Physical AI innovation center.
claims.scope_limit: Company announcement; no independent site inspection.

claims.statement: The company plans an application lab for spectral-sensing demonstrations and feasibility discussions with customers and partners.
claims.text: The company plans an application lab for spectral-sensing demonstrations and feasibility discussions with customers and partners.
claims.scope_limit: Future tense; no evidence the lab already operates.

claims.statement: Si-Ware explains that Si-NIR Mini uses near-infrared spectroscopy to measure material light absorption and spectral signatures.
claims.text: Si-Ware explains that Si-NIR Mini uses near-infrared spectroscopy to measure material light absorption and spectral signatures.
claims.scope_limit: Manufacturer explanation; concept illustration must not impersonate a measured spectrum.

claims.statement: The company-authored demonstration description says contact sensing distinguishes visually similar samples including sugar and gluten-free flour.
claims.text: The company-authored demonstration description says contact sensing distinguishes visually similar samples including sugar and gluten-free flour.
claims.quote: the sensor differentiates the visually identical samples upon contact
claims.scope_limit: Description verified through Vimeo and oEmbed; video not watched; efficacy not independently tested.

claims.statement: The same description says its software can be taught to recognize an unfamiliar sample, illustrating this with whipping cream.
claims.text: The same description says its software can be taught to recognize an unfamiliar sample, illustrating this with whipping cream.
claims.quote: training the system to identify whipping cream
claims.scope_limit: Described demo; no inference that one example ensures robust recognition.

claims.statement: The Si-NIR Mini FAQ specifies contact use and recommends validating performance for each intended application.
claims.text: The Si-NIR Mini FAQ specifies contact use and recommends validating performance for each intended application.
claims.scope_limit: Non-contact use is only a limited possibility; no distant laser identification or food-safety assurance.

claims.statement: Si-Ware proposes using composition information to inform handling, sorting and other machine actions.
claims.text: Si-Ware proposes using composition information to inform handling, sorting and other machine actions.
claims.quote: verifies, handles, sorts, adjusts, or alerts
claims.scope_limit: Potential applications; no independently demonstrated deployed sorting robot or worker outcome.

claims.statement: Si-Ware lists its US office at 8701 N. Mopac Expressway, Suite 480, Austin, Texas 78759-8376.
claims.text: Si-Ware lists its US office at 8701 N. Mopac Expressway, Suite 480, Austin, Texas 78759-8376.
claims.scope_limit: Office listing, not a construction permit. Site footer still has the prior California address.

claims.statement: The office building is in Travis County: the company address matches the street address of a TDLR record that identifies Travis County.
claims.text: The office building is in Travis County: the company address matches the street address of a TDLR record that identifies Travis County.
claims.scope_limit: Geographic inference joining official building location with company office listing. TDLR concerns another tenant; it is not Si-Ware lab evidence.

claims.statement: The company explains that learned models interpret spectral measurements for an intended application.
claims.text: The company explains that learned models interpret spectral measurements for an intended application.
claims.quote: Models learn how those spectral responses relate to the information the application needs.
claims.scope_limit: Company platform description; no performance benchmark verified.

claims.statement: The company describes recognizing inputs outside the system’s learned material knowledge as part of its proposed approach.
claims.text: The company describes recognizing inputs outside the system’s learned material knowledge as part of its proposed approach.
claims.scope_limit: A stated capability or design goal, not measured unknown-detection reliability.

rejected.claim: In the company’s demonstration, contact sensing separates sugar from flour.
rejected.reason: Separates could imply a physical sorting action; only the company’s description was reviewed, not the video or measured performance. Reworded as an attributed distinction claim.

rejected.claim: An unfamiliar sample still needs teaching. The software does not begin knowing everything.
rejected.reason: Overgeneralized beyond the documented database example. Replaced with the company’s described teaching example.

rejected.claim: The planned lab will let robotics teams test what material sensing could add.
rejected.reason: Unqualified future outcome suggests certainty; changed to is meant to help and retained planned.

rejected.claim: An Austin lab or deployed robot already performs these illustrated tasks.
rejected.reason: Announcement establishes office opening but lab is future tense. Conceptual original visuals must not imply observed operation.

rejected.claim: TDLR project proves Si-Ware’s lab construction, timing, cost, or size.
rejected.reason: The TDLR record is another tenant at the same building; retained solely as county evidence.

rejected.claim: The Vimeo film was watched or its motion and performance independently verified.
rejected.reason: Only page description and oEmbed metadata were read. Direct page request returned 403; accessible oEmbed returned matching company description.

rejected.claim: A flour result certifies allergen safety or a sensor recognizes any material at a distance.
rejected.reason: No detection-limit or safety validation supplied; product baseline is contact use with application-specific evaluation.
